QUOTE: Add a `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` with a negative value to the module's public header (for example `include/mbedtls/aes.h`)... Do not edit the `case` lines in `library/error.c`. They are regenerated at build time from the headers, so a manual edit is lost.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the header-define and don't-edit-error.c parts, but never says the define must carry a `/** */` doc comment (the description source). It also says it could not verify where the description text comes from, and never mentions re-running the generator as a step.
